fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Primary key; upstream tournament event identifier

fields.name: event_tier
fields.description: Tournament tier as reported by MunchStats (e.g. International, Regional, Special), if known

fields.name: event_format
fields.description: Competitive format the event was played under, e.g. "gen9championsvgc2026regmc" (Champions, Reg M-C) or "gen9vgc2026regi" (standard VGC). MunchStats indexes both; this dimension is what scopes Champions-only analysis (see dbt/models/intermediate/int_champions_roster.sql). Optional: a few indexed events report no format

fields.name: regulation_code
fields.description: Champions regulation set the event was played under ("m-a", "m-b", "m-c"), resolved exactly from event_format via dbt/seeds/champions_regulations.csv. Same codes as legality_snapshot.regulation_code. Null only for non-Champions (standard VGC) events; a Champions event with no regulation fails assert_champions_formats_registered

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL or endpoint the record was resolved from

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this row was published under
